title: Fix Cagebreak multi-output layer-shell positioning upstream
design: Coordinate an upstream Cagebreak issue and tested PR for per-output layer-shell scene positioning.
notes: Issue #97 reframed as a global Cagebreak multi-output layer-shell bug. PR #98 is open from Nomadcxx:fix/layer-shell-output-position with signed commit e430417.
